name: Tab sessions
responsibility: Sends each tool call and notification to the tab session whose thread it names: that session's coordinator tools and callbacks, and its workhorses
description: Each tab session has its own coordinator, coordinator tools, callbacks, realtime voice and spoken approval, and one workhorse for each checkout, so two tabs can talk at the same time. A notification for a thread that no tab session owns yet goes to every session. A tool call from such a thread is refused, so a running turn never waits on nobody. It stops the workhorses of its tab session for the coordinator's stop tool, and it notes the conversation shown when each coordinator turn starts.

outgoing.label: a tool call from the coordinator
workhorse notifications, tell_coordinator calls
outgoing.description: The callback queue subscribes to the operations and semantic ports passed to the public createCodexCoordinatorCallbacks factory. The incoming event reaches its subscribed callback, not a private import by the publisher.

outgoing.label: unload an ended tab's threads
outgoing.description: The caller receives the unload method of the public createCodexThreadUnload factory imported from the module root; the module is drawn whole.

outgoing.label: refuse a call no session owns
outgoing.description: The server imports answerUnownedTellCoordinator from the callbacks root, which re-exports the implementation in tell-coordinator.ts.

outgoing.label: note a turn's start and the work its operations give
